title: Shaded Beige Toilet Paper Stand, 26-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Tissue Holder, Contemporary Style, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Shaded Beige, freestanding toilet paper stand, 26 inches high, solid brass construction for bathroom use when wall space is limited, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes.
